logical_scope: Closed-constant ground sequent in one-sorted symbolic guarded incidence fragment; Point/Line/Incident are arbitrary predicates. No coordinates, existential line construction, full Hilbert Euclidean theory or universal closure is claimed.
gap: The finite recipe tiles are proof-command placements, not the common machine Wang squares. There is no one-square-to-one-square isomorphism: a primitive inference needs serialized ASTs, interpreter workspace and many physical transition rows.

forward_map.obligation: One selected primitive key per row; reconstruct all t/m from recipe witness and ordered reference offsets; exact target/color, absent versus assigned zero, roots and seeds, full IDs/epochs. Placement execution order is not logical line order.

Sort by row, retain every row including padding/repeated premises. Copy zero-port witnesses literally. For MP, set antecedent/ref[0] and implication/ref[1] to exact row numbers; independently check both precede the row and source formulas match exact implication shape.

Top-level proof has no local assumptions. Retain I.2 and add three explicitly named closed ground axioms hypothesis-0/1/2 equal to Gamma. Translate every assumption(index=i) command to axiom(name=hypothesis-i), retaining formula/row/references. blocks=[]; schemas=[]; target exact code54 AST. This is the same ground sequent relative to Gamma, not a theorem without Gamma.

Independent checker revalidates all selected axiom/instantiate/eq_subst/ordered-MP instances, capture conditions, field types and signature; never infers validity from matching colors. Validate the local certificate under Gamma and the flat request under I.2+Gamma separately.

forward_map.object: Fixed and free postfix boundary words
forward_map.obligation: Fixed word serializes protocol,theory,target in that order. Free word serializes empty blocks then all 24 proof commands. Tagged byte trees use nine little-endian bits per atom0..256 and one cons bit. All object ordering is frozen and retained; do not change nested order or drop commands while claiming exact wire-byte identity.

Use exact boot nodes, current fixed microtable and literal table, true parser start, exact43-band framing/heads. Independently reconstruct full boundary/input bytes and problem hash. Only separately declared blank resources may change; no target-specific transition compilation.

forward_map.object: Native response / symbolic Wang computation certificate
forward_map.obligation: A later explicitly authorized fresh native request and full independent replay establish acceptance or resource unknown. Compact response hierarchy may encode the physical transition computation, but a cropped/local diagram is not a complete accepting rectangle.

inverse_scope: Any independently valid 24-row certificate maps to one request-boundary payload in the fixed shared encoding. The converse only holds for payloads obeying the explicit finite geometry recipe/row grammar; arbitrary shared-palette accepted proofs can use formulas/rules outside this envelope. No bijection or shared-palette GCTS-search equivalence claim.

assumption_map.no_implicit_discharge: A universally quantified conditional theorem requires a separate deduction/eigenvariable closure and resource gate, previously unknown; it is not produced by adding ground hypothesis axioms.

full_palette_cost_obstacle: The published reflexivity control uses229147579770 literal physical transitions. A dense rectangle has one row per literal transition and full input width per row, far beyond a bounded host search. Do not promise free-boundary proof search over the complete physical rectangle in this pilot.
recommended_role: Use the exact complete finite primitive graph for search and the unchanged common checker palette for eventual certificate validation. The first bridge gate tests this concrete specialization; it does not prove the specialization universal or beneficial.
